name: Replacement prospects
zip_income: median >= $70K: cash offer; $50-70K: financing-first; under $50K: skip prospecting
zip_filters: owner-occupied >= 60%; median year built <= 2005; single-family detached share high
meta: Advantage+ on; control age 25, suggestion 35-65+; interests as suggestions: home improvement, roofing, home insurance
google: Search: replacement keywords; observe Homeowners, age 35+, HHI tiers; exclude Renters

name: Storm-hit ZIPs
zip_filters: ZIPs with hail >= 1 in. or wind >= 60 mph in last 7 days
meta: Advantage+ on; geo = affected ZIPs only; control age 25
google: Search + LSA: storm/leak repair terms in affected ZIPs; no demographic exclusions

name: Flat-roof / rowhome
zip_filters: rowhome / attached housing share high; owner-occupied >= 50%
meta: separate ad set and creative; same controls
google: separate ad group: flat roof, rubber roof, roof coating

name: No heat / no AC
homeowner: preferred, not required (landlords and renters call too)
google: Search + LSA: repair terms; no demographic exclusions; run nights/weekends only if phones answered

name: System replacement
google: Search: replacement/heat pump terms; observe Homeowners, age; exclude Renters
seed: past repair customers with equipment 12+ yrs old

name: Tune-up and membership
zip_filters: past customers first; then high-score ZIPs
meta: custom audience of past customers + lookalike
google: Customer Match; Demand Gen to past customers

name: Leak / clog / no hot water
google: LSA + Search carry 85% of budget; no demographic exclusions

name: Water heater replacement
zip_filters: median year built 8-15+ yrs ago; owner-occupied >= 60%
google: Search: water heater terms; observe Homeowners
seed: customers with water heater install date 8+ yrs ago

name: Repipe / sewer line
google: Search: repipe, sewer camera, sewer line replacement

name: Landlords / property managers
google: Search: commercial plumber, property management plumbing

name: Outage / safety emergency
google: Search + LSA: emergency electrician terms

name: Panel / service upgrade
google: Search: panel upgrade, 200 amp; observe Homeowners
seed: past service-call customers in older homes

name: Standby generator
zip_income: median >= $100K or median home value top third of service area
google: Search: whole home generator; HHI bid +, observe Top 30%

name: EV charger + panel
google: Search: EV charger installation; in-market EV segments

name: Exterior repaint
zip_filters: owner-occupied >= 65%; wood/older siding; median home value above area median
google: Search: house painters, exterior painting; observe Homeowners; exclude Renters

name: Interior / cabinets
google: Search: interior painting, cabinet painting

name: HOAs / property managers
google: Search: HOA painting, commercial painting

name: Bill savings (lease/PPA or financed)
zip_filters: high utility rates; net metering available; roof age under 15 yrs or bundle re-roof; low tree cover
meta: Advantage+ on; suggestion 35-65; qualifying lead form (owner, utility, bill, roof age)
google: Search: solar panels [city], solar lease; observe Homeowners; exclude Renters

name: Battery / backup
google: Search: solar battery, home battery backup

name: Recurring maintenance
zip_filters: larger lots; route clustering near current customers
meta: Advantage+ on; suggestion 40-65+; geo = route ZIPs
google: Search: lawn maintenance, lawn care service; observe Homeowners

name: Spring / fall cleanup
google: Search: spring cleanup, leaf removal

name: Hardscape / design
zip_income: median >= $120K or home value top third
google: Search: patio installation, landscape design

name: Snow removal (north)
zip_filters: snowfall days; current maintenance customers first
google: Search: snow removal [city]
